name: LTTH overlay raw-path guard
description: Ordered caller-marker removal and safe raw-path attestation for the overlay Worker.

rules.description: Remove every caller-supplied LTTH raw-path marker on routing authorities.
rules.expression: http.host eq "overlay.ltth.app" or (starts_with(http.host, "r-") and ends_with(http.host, ".ltth.app") and len(http.host) eq 43)

rules.description: Restore the marker only when immutable raw path structure is safe.
rules.expression: (http.host eq "overlay.ltth.app" or (starts_with(http.host, "r-") and ends_with(http.host, ".ltth.app") and len(http.host) eq 43)) and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "\\") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "//") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") eq "/.") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") eq "/..") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "/./") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "/../") and not ends_with(url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r"), "/.") and not ends_with(url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r"), "/..") and not (lower(raw.http.request.uri.path) matches r"%(?:25)*2f")
